main_text.p: Chaldæis litera ה eft fervilis, & ף etiam apud Talmudicos, ו vero radicalis, quibus & hoc peculiare eft quod deficientem fecundam compenfent per Daghes forte in prima, non in tertia, quotiescunque præfigitur characteristica litera temporis, ut הִוְיִקְ[?] comminnerant. Dan.6.24. à פִּפְּ[?].

main_text.p: I. Initio. 1. Formativas Derivatorum, feptem, הַאָמְנָתִי[?], quæ literæ Heemanticæ dicuntur.
II. In medio expletivas Vocalium ו[?]

p.i: Da principio, vel ⅃, medioque, vel indas ⅃, vel conduplices mediam, seu ה dato fini:

page.notes: The Hebrew throughout is only partly legible on the scan. Words marked [?] are my best reading of the letters, and the Hebrew mnemonic words (האמנתי, משה וכלב, איתן) may differ in detail. Where a Hebrew line could not be read letter by letter it is marked illegible with an approximate letter count. The Greek-looking marks and the small Hebrew vowel signs are not reliably recoverable. "Abjice" is a standalone label in the printed page and is kept as a paragraph. "Dan.6.24." is printed as given.
